body: Made it up the lake trail before sunrise. Worth every step.
First loaf from the new starter! Crust came out better than I expected.
Long shift done. Grateful for the coworkers who made it bearable.
Sunday dinner for twelve. Recipe in the comments if anyone wants it.
Nothing biting today but what a view.
Does anyone know a good repair shop for espresso machines? Mine is making a terrible noise.
Club 5K this Saturday. All paces welcome. Bring a friend!
Trying to eat more greens this month. Day 4 and still going.
My daughter lost her first tooth today and asked if the tooth fairy takes cards.
Weekend trip to the coast. Already planning the next one.
Who else thinks pineapple belongs on pizza? Asking for a friend.
Evening walk. The sky did all the work.
Found the repair shop. Machine is fixed and so is my mood.
Finally caught one! Pictures tomorrow when I get home.
Great turnout at the 5K. Thanks to everyone who came out.
